description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ihala Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420501 (23/0812)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
